scope: Future computationally intensive tasks; historical evidence unchanged
accounting: Wall-clock elapsed time of one command invocation and its computational descendants; no accumulation across separate commands
excluded_intervals: explicit stopped intervals with no computational workers
default_stage_timeout_reason: Allocate from evidence within this command's maximum; no inherited 120-second default
uncalibrated_probability_reason: Use concrete diagnostics and state uncertainty; never invent a probability
